description: A history read refused by name (DB19): the drill-down cannot find the id in scope, or a live entry is asked of the archived door (or vice versa) — a wrong fetch, never an empty read. The reason travels in `what` verbatim so the app shows 'not found / wrong door', not a confident empty transcript: an archived loop read as empty would lie, a live one asked of the archive door would lie. The code is the history read's own (-31800), not the framework's store-absence.

data.what: no loop or archive with id "no-such-loop" in scope
data.means: the id names no loop or archive in scope, or a live entry was asked of the archived door (or vice versa) — the refusal travels verbatim, never read as empty (DB19)
